newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Montenegro to start $117 mln water project - Beta.
newsitem.headline: Montenegro to start $117 mln water project - Beta.

text.p: Construction of Montenegro's coastal water pipeline will start in September with the delivery of first pipes by the Slovak partner, Beta news agency reported on Monday.
The $117 million dollar project will be carried out by a Montenegrin-Slovak joint venture Montenegro-Casovija based in Budva, on the Montenegrin coast.
The firm, in which the foreign partner has a 51 percent stake, was founded last month by Montenegro's coastal waterwarks Regionalni vodovod Crnogorsko primorje and eastern Slovak steel works Kosice.
The entire works are to be completed in two and a half to three years, director of Regionalni vodovod, Rade Gregovic was quoted by the agency as saying.
